newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 336,000 barrels in the week ended June 6 to 323.96 million barrels from 323.62 million barrels the previous week, the American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 50,000 barrels in the week to 255.97 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 1.94 million barrels to 109.25 million barrels from 107.32 million barrels the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 2.31 million barrels to 37.03 million barrels.
It said gasoline production fell 216,000 barrels in the week to 7.98 million bpd from 8.20 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks rose 2.71 million barrels in the week to 202.44 million barrels from 199.72 million barrels the previous week.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 98.3 percent from 98.4 percent the previous week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 1.28 million barrels to 39.48 million barrels from 38.20 million barrels the previous week.
API also said crude runs refinery operating rate excluding PADD 5 fell to 98.6 percent in the week from 99.9 percent the previous week.
API said total crude runs to processing units fell to 15.17 million barrels per day from 15.21 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 40.93 million barrels from 39.85 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 8.43 million barrels per day from 8.37 million, API said.
